versions.changelog:
- Initial release of "bugfix-workflow" skill.
- Provides a structured workflow for distinguishing and fixing real bugs versus feature change requests.
- Outlines clear steps for simple (quick fix) and complex (full investigation and report) bug scenarios.
- Enforces best practices: always validate bugs, require testing/verification, and generate repair reports for complex issues.
- Strongly promotes minimal, targeted code changes and discourages unnecessary refactoring during bug fixes.
